<section class="grignan-home">

<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Comfortaa:wght@700&display=swap');

/* =====================================
   FOND ET DÉCORATIONS
===================================== */

html, body, #quarto-content {
  background-color: #F4F0E8 !important;
}

.grignan-home {
  font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
  color: #293747;
  max-width: 900px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.grignan-home * {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* LAVANDE À DROITE */

.lavande-filigrane {
  position: fixed;
  right: 15px;
  bottom: 10px;
  width: 190px;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.17;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

/* ÉPI DE BLÉ À GAUCHE */

.ble-filigrane {
  position: fixed;
  left: 8px;
  bottom: 15px;
  width: 175px;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.19;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

/* =====================================
   TITRE DOSSIER & INTRODUCTION
===================================== */

.gh-dossier-title {
  text-align: center;
  margin: 35px 0 38px;
  padding: 28px 24px;
  background: #f0f7ed;
  border: 2px solid #b7d7ad;
  border-radius: 14px;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 14px rgba(56, 118, 60, 0.08);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.gh-dossier-hero-bg {
  position: absolute;
  right: -14px;
  bottom: -16px;
  width: 215px;
  height: 215px;
  opacity: 0.10;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
  transform: rotate(-7deg);
}

.gh-dossier-title > *:not(.gh-dossier-hero-bg) {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.gh-section-badge {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  padding: 5px 13px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: #d8ebd2;
  color: #38662e;
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', sans-serif;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.4px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.grignan-home .gh-dossier-title h2 {
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  font-size: 30px !important;
  color: #26394d !important;
  margin: 0 0 14px !important;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  text-align: center !important;
}

.gh-dossier-title p {
  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: #4a5568;
  margin: 0 auto;
  max-width: 720px;
}

/* =====================================
   GRILLE DES AFFICHES & TRACTS
===================================== */

.posters-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 24px;
}

.poster-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  text-align: left;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 24px;
  background: #f7f8f8;
  border: 1px solid #d5e2d2;
  border-radius: 10px;
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}

.poster-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow: 0 5px 18px rgba(41,55,71,0.08);
}

.poster-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  width: 100%;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  gap: 8px;
}

.poster-number {
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', sans-serif;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #5a7d4a;
}

.poster-format {
  padding: 3px 9px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: #e3efe0;
  color: #38662e;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

/* APERÇU VISUEL DE L'AFFICHE */

.poster-preview-link {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #d9e4d6;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 10px;
  text-decoration: none;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: border-color 0.2s ease;
}

.poster-preview-link:hover {
  border-color: #568239;
}

.poster-preview-img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 1 / 1.414;
  object-fit: contain;
  background: #fdfcfb;
  border-radius: 4px;
}

.poster-zoom-hint {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 8px;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: #6c7f92;
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* TEXTE DE LA CARTE */

.grignan-home .poster-card h2 {
  display: block !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  text-align: left !important;
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', Arial, sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 18px !important;
  line-height: 1.4 !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: #293747 !important;
  margin: 0 0 10px !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  float: none !important;
}

.poster-desc {
  font-size: 13.5px;
  line-height: 1.55;
  color: #435264;
  margin: 0 0 18px;
}

/* BOUTONS D'ACTION */

.poster-actions {
  width: 100%;
  margin-top: auto;
  padding-top: 15px;
  border-top: 1px solid #e1e5e7;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 9px;
}

.poster-btn-primary {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 6px;
  flex: 1 1 45%;
  padding: 9px 11px;
  background-color: #568239;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: background-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.15s ease;
}

.poster-btn-primary:hover {
  background-color: #43692B;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.poster-btn-secondary {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 6px;
  flex: 1 1 45%;
  padding: 9px 11px;
  background-color: #ffffff;
  color: #38662e !important;
  border: 1px solid #96be8a;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color 0.2s ease;
}

.poster-btn-secondary--inline {
  flex: 0 1 auto;
  padding: 9px 14px;
}

.poster-btn-secondary:hover {
  background-color: #edf6ea;
}

/* SÉPARATION */

.elus-separator {
  margin: 38px 0 30px;
  border: 0;
  border-top: 1px solid #e1e5e7;
}

/* =====================================
   GUIDE PRATIQUE D'IMPRESSION
===================================== */

.methodology {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 900px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  color: #293747;
}

.methodology-letter {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 794px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 50px 58px;
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #e5e8eb;
  border-radius: 3px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(41,55,71,0.07);
}

.methodology-header {
  display: block !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  text-align: center !important;
  margin: 0 auto 24px;
  padding-bottom: 16px;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #dce2e8;
}

.methodology-surtitle {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  text-align: center !important;
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #78899a;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.methodology-title {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 14px;
  width: 100%;
}

.methodology-icon-svg {
  display: block;
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.grignan-home .methodology-title h2 {
  display: block !important;
  width: auto !important;
  max-width: none !important;
  text-align: center !important;
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', Arial, sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 21px !important;
  line-height: 1.4 !important;
  color: #293f56 !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  float: none !important;
  text-indent: 0 !important;
}

.methodology-section {
  display: flex;
  gap: 13px;
  padding: 13px 15px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  border-left: 5px solid;
  align-items: flex-start;
}

.methodology-number {
  min-width: 29px;
  width: 29px;
  height: 29px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-weight: bold;
  font-size: 13px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  color: white;
}

.methodology-content {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.grignan-home .methodology-content h3 {
  display: block !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  text-align: left !important;
  font-family: Arial, sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  line-height: 1.4 !important;
  margin: 2px 0 5px !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  font-weight: bold !important;
}

.methodology-content p {
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.55;
  margin: 0;
  color: #435264;
}

.method-teal {
  background: #eaf4f2;
  border-color: #5d978b;
}

.method-teal .methodology-number {
  background: #5d978b;
}

.method-teal h3 {
  color: #39766b !important;
}

.method-ochre {
  background: #f8f1e5;
  border-color: #c39a54;
}

.method-ochre .methodology-number {
  background: #c39a54;
}

.method-ochre h3 {
  color: #967337 !important;
}

.method-blue {
  background: #edf3f8;
  border-color: #547b9f;
}

.method-blue .methodology-number {
  background: #547b9f;
}

.method-blue h3 {
  color: #385d7d !important;
}

.methodology-footer {
  margin-top: 22px;
  padding-top: 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid #dce2e8;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 10px;
  color: #82909d;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

/* =====================================
   RESPONSIVE
===================================== */

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .posters-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 18px;
  }

  .poster-card {
    padding: 20px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .grignan-home .gh-dossier-title h2 {
    font-size: 25px !important;
  }

  .gh-dossier-hero-bg {
    width: 150px;
    height: 150px;
    right: -22px;
    bottom: -18px;
  }

  .gh-dossier-title p {
    font-size: 16px;
    padding: 0 10px;
  }

  .methodology-letter {
    padding: 28px 18px;
  }

  .methodology-title {
    gap: 9px;
  }

  .methodology-icon-svg {
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
  }

  .grignan-home .methodology-title h2 {
    font-size: 17px !important;
  }

  .lavande-filigrane {
    width: 110px;
    right: -12px;
    bottom: 5px;
    opacity: 0.12;
  }

  .ble-filigrane {
    width: 105px;
    left: -15px;
    bottom: 5px;
    opacity: 0.13;
  }
}
</style>

<div class="methodology">

    <section class="methodology-section method-teal">
      <div class="methodology-number">1</div>
      <div class="methodology-content">
        <h3>Format d'impression recommandé</h3>
        <p>
          Les deux formats <strong>A4</strong> (21 × 29,7 cm) et <strong>A5</strong> (14,8 × 21 cm) sont directement mis à votre disposition pour s'adapter à vos besoins : le format A4 pour un affichage lisible et le format A5 pour une distribution pratique de main à main ou en boîte aux lettres.
        </p>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="methodology-section method-ochre">
      <div class="methodology-number">2</div>
      <div class="methodology-content">
        <h3>Actions et lieux de diffusion de proximité</h3>
        <p>
          <strong>Distribuez des tracts sur le marché</strong>, <strong>discutez à la sortie de l’école</strong>, <strong>affichez à votre fenêtre ou derrière votre voiture</strong> et déposez-en dans les <strong>boîtes à livres</strong>. Pensez aussi aux panneaux d'affichage libre communaux, aux vitrines de commerçants (avec leur accord) et aux boîtes aux lettres (hors mentions « Stop Pub »).
        </p>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="methodology-section method-blue">
      <div class="methodology-number">3</div>
      <div class="methodology-content">
        <h3>Diffusion sur les réseaux sociaux</h3>
        <p>
          Partagez les visuels en public ou auprès de vos proches via <strong>Facebook, Instagram, Twitter/X, Telegram, WhatsApp</strong>, etc., afin de relayer l'information au-delà du village.
        </p>
      </div>
    </section>

    <footer class="methodology-footer">
      FOUR BANAL DE GRIGNAN · SUPPORTS D'INFORMATION CITOYENNE
    </footer>

     SCRIPT D'IMPRESSION DIRECTE DE L'IMAGE

<script>
function imprimerImage(url) {
  const fenetreImpression = window.open('', '_blank');
  if (!fenetreImpression) return;
  fenetreImpression.document.write(`
    <!DOCTYPE html>
    <html lang="fr">
    <head>
      <meta charset="utf-8">
      <title>Impression du support</title>
      <style>
        @page { margin: 8mm; }
        body {
          margin: 0;
          display: flex;
          justify-content: center;
          align-items: center;
          min-height: 100vh;
          background: #ffffff;
        }
        img {
          max-width: 100%;
          max-height: 96vh;
          height: auto;
          display: block;
        }
      </style>
    </head>
    <body>
      <img src="${url}" onload="window.print(); window.close();">
    </body>
    </html>
  `);
  fenetreImpression.document.close();
}
</script>

</section>
